summary: Correct, targeted fix that wraps a `None` return annotation in `:obj:`None`` so it renders as an intersphinx link in both signature and description modes, matching how autodoc handles other types. Resolves the reported inconsistency without regression risk.

issues.description: The 'None' → ':obj:`None`' conversion is duplicated in record_typehints and modify_field_list. Since record_typehints is the sole populator of annotations['return'], the check in modify_field_list is effectively defensive/redundant; a small helper or single conversion point would be cleaner.

Only bare 'None' is special-cased. Composite hints containing None (e.g. Optional[int] stringifying to 'Optional[int, None]'-style forms) are not linked, but that is outside the scope of this issue and consistent with how the rest of the module treats stringified annotations.
